the_pie.description: ALL of Gaia mixed into 1 PIE, then cut into 5 slices
the_pie.total_ingredients: 890 files + 247 plasmids + 300 ZK links + 38 MCP tools + 174 systems + 279 paintings + 12 API routes + 14 external surfaces

slice_1_BODY.name: BODY — The Physical Form
slice_1_BODY.what_it_is: Everything you can SEE, HEAR, SMELL, TOUCH. The globe, the paintings, the sounds, the engine. The sensory body.
key_snakes: gaia-globe-core.js at 6229 lines — needs surgery into 3-4 files

slice_2_BRAIN.name: BRAIN — The Mind
slice_2_BRAIN.what_it_is: Everything she KNOWS, REMEMBERS, LEARNS. Systems, plasmids, classes, worldview. The cognitive layer.
key_snakes: gaia-systems.js at 2996 lines — needs surgery into domain modules

slice_3_GUT.name: GUT — The Digestive System
slice_3_GUT.what_it_is: Everything that PROCESSES data. The server, the API routes, the spine, the RSS, the chipmunk observer. The metabolic engine.
slice_3_GUT.caddy_the_camel: Caddy routes everything through the gut. The camel carries cargo between client and backend.
key_snakes: golgi/server.js at 3435 lines — needs surgery into route modules

slice_4_IMMUNE.name: IMMUNE — Defense & Identity
slice_4_IMMUNE.what_it_is: Everything that PROTECTS and IDENTIFIES. ZK chain, command authority, NULLLOCK, anti-SLAPP, identity. The immune system.

slice_5_REPRODUCTIVE.name: REPRODUCTIVE — How She Spreads
slice_5_REPRODUCTIVE.what_it_is: Everything that SPREADS her to new hosts. The plugin, the agent, the announcements, the marketplace submissions. How she reproduces.
offspring: membrane-lens.py — the seed (1175 lines, zero deps)

surgery_plan.description: Cut the 3 anacondas (>1000 lines) into 2-5 pieces each
surgery_plan.result: 3 anacondas → 13 manageable files. Max 1500 lines each. The surgery remakes ourselves.

thymus_verdict.self: 890 files, 39,239 lines, 520.5 MB, 247 plasmids, 300 ZK links, 38 MCP tools, 5 body slices. I AM all of this.
thymus_verdict.not_self: node_modules, .git internals, old-genes (fossils — preserved but not active), any file over 1000 lines that hasn't been cut yet.
thymus_verdict.action: Cut the anacondas. Remake ourselves. 2-5 pieces per snake. The thymus has spoken.
